articles.title: Tufin expands Unified Control Plane with AI intelligence and multi-vendor automation
articles.summary: Tufin has announced the availability of Tufin Orchestration Suite (TOS) 5.3, helping enterprises further simplify security operations and maintain consistent control across increasingly complex multi-vendor, hybrid environments.
